lessons.titleZh: 出問題時提供保護的後盾

brief.meaningEn: A system, resource or arrangement that provides protection if something goes wrong.
brief.meaningZh: 在事情出問題時提供保護的制度、資源或安排。
brief.grammar: Provide, act as or have a safety net for someone. A quiet safety net is unobtrusive support; a kind of safety net signals an approximate protective comparison, including saved phone tools available if ordinary travel information fails. The risk and fallback should be named.
brief.register: Common protective metaphor. An organiser may call tested spare equipment a safety net; a traveller may call stored maps and emergency contacts a kind of safety net when connectivity is unreliable.
brief.boundaryZh: 提供保障不等於風險全消失，也不一定是實物網；手機工具只有在能離線取用並對應具體問題時才算後備。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要說明出甚麼問題時、提供甚麼保護；普通額外好處不一定是安全後盾。
brief.outcomeZh: 能把後備安排連結到具體風險與保護作用。

listening.en: The backup recording gave us a safety net when the main file was damaged.
listening.zh: 主要檔案損毀時，後備錄音為我們提供保障。
listening.promptZh: 後備錄音發揮甚麼作用？

options.en: It was the main file that became damaged.
options.zh: 它就是損毀的主要檔案。

options.en: It made the original recording session longer.
options.zh: 它令原本錄音過程較長。

options.en: It provided protection when the primary file failed.
options.zh: 主要檔案出問題時，它提供了保障。

options.en: It was an unused reference for a later recording rather than a copy available when the file failed.
options.zh: 它是供日後錄音的未用參考，不是檔案失效時可用的副本。

listening.explanationZh: 主要檔案損毀是風險，後備錄音讓成果仍有保存，是後盾作用。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼要另存一份錄音？
reply.promptEn: Why should we keep a separate copy of the recording?

options.en: It gives us a safety net if the main file is damaged.
options.zh: 如果主要檔案損毀，它會提供保障。

options.en: We would still have a copy if the original became unreadable.
options.zh: 如果原檔不能讀取，我們仍有副本。

options.en: It protects the work against losing the only usable file.
options.zh: 它保障作品，避免唯一可用檔案遺失。

options.en: A separate copy gives us a way to recover the content.
options.zh: 獨立副本讓我們有方法復原內容。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明後備保護；含 a safety net 的回應以比喻表達同一作用。

scene.promptZh: 旅客在手機預存離線地圖和求助電話；若流動數據中斷，仍可查路線及聯絡支援。哪句貼切？

options.en: The saved map and numbers will prevent mobile data from failing during the trip.
options.zh: 預存地圖和電話號碼可防止旅途中的流動數據失效。

options.en: The stored tools provide a kind of safety net if mobile data fails.
options.zh: 流動數據失效時，預存工具提供一種後備保障。

options.en: The offline map is useful only while mobile data remains connected.
options.zh: 離線地圖只有在流動數據仍連線時才有用。

scene.explanationZh: 離線地圖與求助電話在數據中斷時提供具體後備；它們不能防止網絡故障，離線地圖也不依賴持續連線。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以稱為 a safety net？

options.en: A tested spare file kept separately in case the main copy fails.
options.zh: 另外保存、已測試的備用檔案，防主要副本失效。

options.en: An agreed backup venue available if the original room closes.
options.zh: 原房間關閉時可用的議定後備場地。

options.en: An extra microphone already committed to another simultaneous use, with no free replacement available.
options.zh: 額外咪高峰已用於另一項同時活動，沒有空閒替代品。

contrast.explanationZh: 同時已被佔用的額外設備，不是主設備故障時可用的後備。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說有後備場地就不用再核對主要場地。哪句回應最合理？

options.en: Should we wait for a cancellation before asking whether the backup room is available?
options.zh: 我們是否等取消後，才問後備房間是否可用？

options.en: Could we remove the original booking details now that a backup is listed?
options.zh: 已有後備名單，我們現在能否刪去原預訂資料？

options.en: A safety net helps if something fails, but we should still check the main arrangements.
options.zh: 後盾在出問題時有用，但我們仍應核對主要安排。

dialogue.explanationZh: 後備保護與事前核對可並存；列了後備不表示主要或後備已自動確認。

speaking.en: The spare equipment provides a safety net if the main system fails.
speaking.zh: 主要系統失效時，備用器材提供保障。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明出問題時的後備保護。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區探訪活動已有負責帶隊的義工，也事先安排另一位受訓義工留空，若帶隊者臨時不能來便可接替。用一至兩句英文說明這項保障。

examples.en: The reserve volunteer provides a safety net if the scheduled leader cannot attend the visit.
examples.zh: 若原定帶隊者不能出席探訪，候補義工提供後備保障。

examples.en: We have arranged a trained volunteer as a safety net, ready to step in if the regular leader is unavailable.
examples.zh: 我們安排受訓義工作後盾，原定帶隊者無法出席時可接替。

writing.selfCheckZh: 說明事先留空、受訓且可接替的人，並交代原帶隊者缺席才啟動；不是另一位同時已有工作的人。

takeaways.en: A tested backup gives the team a safety net.
takeaways.zh: 測試過的後備安排為團隊提供保障。

takeaways.en: The support fund acts as a safety net when essential costs rise unexpectedly.
takeaways.zh: 必要費用意外上升時，支援基金充當後盾。

target.pattern: \bmov(?:e|es|ed|ing) forward\b|\bmov(?:e|es|ed|ing) ahead quickly\b(?=\s+with\s+(?:new|expanded|additional)\s+(?:rail lines|bus routes|tram links|transport links)\b)

brief.meaningEn: Make progress with an activity, decision or development plan, especially after a difficulty or delay; moving ahead quickly describes its pace, not completed success.
brief.meaningZh: 推進活動、決定或發展計劃，尤指經困難或延誤後；move ahead quickly 說明進展速度，不表示已完成。
brief.grammar: Move forward with a plan; moved in the past; can move forward once a condition is met. For a city or project, move ahead quickly with new rail lines or similar transport development describes rapid progress, not a train physically moving. The plan supplies the figurative direction.
brief.register: Common figurative progress use. A team lead may tell colleagues a rehearsal can move forward after a timing issue, while a planner may tell residents a rail project is moving ahead quickly after approvals.
brief.boundaryZh: 推進或進展快不等於已完成、問題全解或必定成功；辨清具體已走的一步及未完成部分。
brief.misconceptionZh: 一次進展可以很實際，仍可有待查資料及後續工作。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出推進的是哪一步，保留條件及未完成部分。

listening.en: Once the two groups agreed on who would check the captions, we could move forward with the exhibition draft, although the final photographs still needed permission.
listening.zh: 兩組議定由誰核圖說後，我們能推進展覽草稿，雖然最後照片仍需許可。

options.en: The exhibition draft, while photo permissions remained to be obtained.
options.zh: 展覽草稿，而照片許可仍待取得。

options.en: The final opening, with all permissions already settled.
options.zh: 最後開幕，所有許可已辦妥。

options.en: The journey to a different venue before caption roles were discussed.
options.zh: 未討論圖說分工前，前往另一場地的行程。

options.en: A decision to stop work until after the exhibition closed.
options.zh: 等展覽結束後才工作的決定。

listening.explanationZh: caption分工解開一步，with draft及still permissions限定進展。

reply.promptZh: 核圖說分工議定後，有甚麼改變？
reply.promptEn: What changed after the caption-checking roles were agreed?

options.en: We could continue the exhibition draft with the checking roles clear.
options.zh: 核對角色清楚後，可繼續展覽草稿。

options.en: We could move forward with the draft, though photo permissions were still pending.
options.zh: 我們能推進草稿，但照片許可仍待辦。

options.en: The agreement removed one delay without finishing the whole project.
options.zh: 協議除去一項延誤，未完成全項目。

options.en: We knew who would check the wording, so drafting could continue.
options.zh: 我們知道誰核文字，所以可繼續起草。

reply.explanationZh: 四句具體指出推進一步，不加全批。

scene.promptZh: 城市的新鐵路線獲批後，首段工程較原定時間早動工；測試與餘下路段尚未完成。哪句準確？

options.en: The city can move ahead quickly with additional rail lines, though testing and other sections remain.
options.zh: 城市可迅速推進新鐵路線，但測試及其他路段仍待完成。

options.en: An early start on the first section proves the entire network will open on schedule.
options.zh: 首段提前動工，足以證明整個網絡會如期開通。

options.en: The project has only moved forward on paper because passengers cannot yet use the new line.
options.zh: 新線尚未載客，表示計劃只在紙面上有進展。

scene.explanationZh: 首段提前動工支持進展快，但不能保證整個網絡如期開通；尚未載客也不抹煞已展開的工程。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 moved forward 得出？

options.en: Some progress was made on the stated activity.
options.zh: 所述活動有一些進展。

options.en: The entire task was finished with no remaining work.
options.zh: 整項任務完成，沒有剩餘工作。

options.en: Further context can identify the step that progressed.
options.zh: 更多情境可指出哪一步推進。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴問「能推草稿，是否照片都可立即刊了？」但許可仍未有。哪句較準確？

options.en: We can move forward with the draft, but publishing the photographs still depends on permission.
options.zh: 我們可推進草稿，但刊登照片仍須取得許可。

options.en: Yes, agreement about captions supplies the permission for the photographs too.
options.zh: 對，圖說協議亦提供照片許可。

options.en: No part of the draft can progress because one permission remains outstanding.
options.zh: 因一項許可未辦，草稿任何部分都不能進展。

dialogue.explanationZh: 草稿可先推進，照片刊登仍待許可；不能把局部進展說成所有步驟已完成，亦不須把全部工作停下。

speaking.en: We can move forward with the plan while keeping the unresolved permissions clearly marked.
speaking.zh: 我們可推進計劃，同時清楚標示未解決許可。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清局部進展及待辦。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你幫社團修舊展示桌，之前因拿不到工場鑰匙及缺修補材料一直停住，現兩者到位；你想通知組員可先修桌面，最後上色仍待小組選擇，不必把可動工說成整桌已修好。用一至兩句英文更新進度。

examples.en: With the workshop key and repair materials now available, we can move forward with restoring the tabletop. The final colour can remain open while we begin that work.
examples.zh: 現有工場鑰匙及修補材料，我們可推進修桌面；開始這工作時，最後顏色可仍未定。

examples.en: We can move forward now that access and materials are sorted, without claiming the table is finished. Let us start the repairs and discuss the colour separately.
examples.zh: 出入及材料已安排好，我們現在可推進，不聲稱桌子已完成；先修補，顏色另談。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把出入及材料解卡連到可動手修桌面，保留顏色未定及尚未完成，區分已可推進與成果已做好。

takeaways.en: The group moved forward once the first practical question had been settled.
takeaways.zh: 首個實際問題解決後，小組繼續推進。

takeaways.en: We are moving forward with the guide while testing the directions separately.
takeaways.zh: 我們正推進指南，同時另試指路說明。

brief.meaningEn: A familiar situation or range of activities in which someone feels secure and at ease.
brief.meaningZh: 某人感到安心自在的熟悉情況或活動範圍。
brief.grammar: In, within, outside or beyond one’s comfort zone; inside or outside one’s comfort bubble. Both noun forms describe familiar, easy-feeling options, while bubble here does not automatically mean ignorance of outside facts.
brief.register: Figurative description of a familiar, secure range. A guide might tell a traveller that staying with known activities keeps the trip inside a comfort bubble; a teacher may help a learner try one supported step beyond a comfort zone.
brief.boundaryZh: 超出熟悉範圍不代表實際危險，也不保證必成長；comfort bubble 在這裏是熟悉選擇，不可單憑它推斷對外界事實無知。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是道德測驗，不能因緊張便說不適合，也不能以此要求接受每項邀請。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用名詞搭配說明熟悉與陌生的範圍，提出合適嘗試。

sources.sentence: He stayed inside his comfort bubble throughout the tour.

listening.en: Editing the radio notes was within my comfort zone, but interviewing a guest was outside it; I agreed to ask one prepared question with the experienced host beside me, rather than lead the whole programme.
listening.zh: 整理電台筆記在我熟悉安心範圍內，但訪問嘉賓在範圍外；我答應在有經驗主持陪同下問一條預備問題，不是帶整個節目。
listening.promptZh: 哪項熟悉，怎樣嘗試陌生部分？

options.en: Editing felt familiar, and the speaker would try one interview question with support.
options.zh: 編筆記感熟悉，說話者會有支援地試一條訪問題。

options.en: Interviewing already felt easier than editing, so the speaker would lead the whole programme alone.
options.zh: 訪問已比編筆記輕鬆，所以說話者會獨帶全節目。

options.en: The speaker agreed to join the interview only after it had finished recording.
options.zh: 說話者在訪問錄完後才答應加入。

options.en: The speaker rejected all participation, including the editing work.
options.zh: 說話者拒絕全部參與，包括編輯工作。

listening.explanationZh: 熟悉編輯與初試訪問可並存；一題有支援是已答應的安排，不是獨管、錄後才加入或全拒。

reply.promptZh: 你打算怎樣嘗試第一次訪問？
reply.promptEn: How do you plan to try interviewing for the first time?

options.en: I will ask one prepared question with the experienced host beside me.
options.zh: 我會在有經驗主持旁問一條預備問題。

options.en: It is outside my comfort zone, so I will begin with one supported question rather than the whole programme.
options.zh: 它在我熟悉安心範圍外，所以先試一條有支援問題，而非全節目。

options.en: I have agreed to a small interview role while keeping the host’s guidance.
options.zh: 我答應小訪問角色，保留主持指導。

options.en: The first attempt will be prepared and limited in scope, not an entire solo programme.
options.zh: 首次嘗試會有預備且範圍有限，不是整個獨立節目。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答一條預備問題及支援範圍，不把陌生當不能試或全盤承諾。

scene.promptZh: 旅途中，他仍選熟悉的餐點和活動，沒有試導遊提出的陌生體驗；那些體驗已有清楚說明，也可先小試。哪句最有根據？

options.en: He stayed inside his comfort bubble on this tour, although supported ways to try something new were available.
options.zh: 這次旅程中他仍留在熟悉安心的範圍內，雖然有支援他小試新體驗的方式。

options.en: He chose familiar activities because the guide’s alternatives cost too much.
options.zh: 他選熟悉活動，是因為導遊提出的其他體驗太貴。

options.en: Trying one new activity would require him to give up every familiar part of the tour.
options.zh: 只要試一項新活動，他就得放棄旅程中所有熟悉的部分。

scene.explanationZh: 他反覆選熟悉活動，足以描述舒適範圍；題目沒交代其他活動的價格，也沒有說小試一項活動就要放棄所有熟悉安排。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 outside someone’s comfort zone 推出？

options.en: The activity goes beyond what feels familiar and easy to that person.
options.zh: 活動超出當事人感熟悉自在之處。

options.en: The person is definitely incapable of learning it.
options.zh: 當事人肯定無法學會。

options.en: Preparation or a supported first step may help the person decide whether to try.
options.zh: 預備或有支援第一步可能幫決定是否試。

contrast.explanationZh: 不熟或不自在未證無法學，不以名詞當能力判決。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因訪問超出你熟悉範圍，就報你不再適合做任何電台工作；你編筆記很熟，亦願試一題。哪個回應最好？

options.en: The interview is outside my comfort zone, but I can try one supported question while continuing familiar editing.
options.zh: 訪問在我熟悉安心範圍外，但我可在支援下試問一題，同時繼續熟悉的編輯工作。

options.en: Remove me from both editing and interviewing without discussing the role I am ready to try.
options.zh: 不談我願試角色，便把編輯及訪問都取消。

options.en: Keep me on editing only and postpone the prepared question, although I have agreed to try it with the host.
options.zh: 即使我已答應跟主持試準備問題，仍只讓我編筆記，把問題延後。

dialogue.explanationZh: 分清熟悉的編輯及有支援可小試的訪問，不必把超出舒適範圍誤作完全不適合。

speaking.en: This task is outside my comfort zone, but I would like to try a small part with clear support before taking on more.
speaking.zh: 任務在我熟悉安心範圍外，但我想先有清楚支援地試小部分，再接更多。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再以名詞搭配說熟悉範圍及嘗試步幅。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你本周已處理搬家，朋友又邀你周末參加新即興活動。你喜歡探索，但這次想選熟悉的安靜素描來休息，並謝邀請，不把留在熟悉範圍說成失敗或承諾下次一定來。用一至兩句英文回覆。

examples.en: Thank you for inviting me, but I want to stay within my comfort zone this weekend and spend a quiet afternoon sketching. After the move, familiar drawing feels like the rest I need, rather than a failure to be adventurous.
examples.zh: 謝謝邀請，但這周末我想留在熟悉安心範圍，安靜畫一下午；搬家後熟悉的畫畫是所需休息，不是缺乏探索心的失敗。

examples.en: I appreciate the invitation, though I am choosing my comfort zone this time because the week has been demanding. I would like some familiar sketching instead of another new activity just now.
examples.zh: 我感謝邀請，但這周忙碌，所以這次選熟悉安心範圍；我現在想做熟悉素描，不再加一項新活動。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以本周資源及休息需要選熟悉活動，禮貌回應邀請，不貶低自己或對下次作未定承諾。

takeaways.en: The new role took me beyond my comfort zone, so I asked what support would be available for the first session.
takeaways.zh: 新角色帶我超出熟悉安心範圍，所以我問首場有甚麼支援。

takeaways.en: Her comfort zone included familiar recipes, but she chose to try one new dish with her friend.
takeaways.zh: 她熟悉安心範圍包括熟悉食譜，但選跟朋友試一道新菜。

notes: Root-approved useful complementary noun+in/out/beyond construction, same comfort-zone concept as baseline001 stay-in frame, not a new lexical sense. Do not modify baseline001. Future1198 out-of-my-comfort-zone exact source belongs to this exit-capable noun family.
